sops.text: On detecting porosity in a casting: (1) verify pour temperature against target 720 ± 5 C; (2) check degasser N2 flow rate against spec; (3) inspect die-coat thickness. To raise pour temperature, increase the induction setpoint by 8 C and recheck after 4 minutes.

If burr defects rise on Line 2 magnet assembly: (1) check press tooling for edge wear and replace if beyond 0.05 mm; (2) verify the deburr-station brush pressure is 2.5-3.0 bar; (3) confirm incoming magnet lot dimensions. A burr rate above 3% requires quarantining the current lot and flagging the supplier.

On a spindle vibration or sustained energy-draw anomaly: (1) log the vibration RMS and compare to the 4.5 mm/s alarm threshold; (2) schedule a condition-monitoring check before the next changeover; (3) a sustained +0.15 kWh/unit residual usually indicates early bearing degradation - plan bearing replacement within 2 weeks.

For harness crimp misalignment: (1) verify terminal seating and crimp height against the applicator spec; (2) run a pull-force test (min 80 N); (3) re-calibrate the applicator if three consecutive parts fail seating.

On ECU solder voids: (1) check reflow oven profile against the paste datasheet (peak 245 C); (2) verify solder-paste age and storage; (3) X-ray a sample of 5 boards. Void area above 25% under BGA requires rework.
